issues.description: The problem statement (UML) declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as a public method, but the solution implements it with protected visibility. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended API and could prevent them from following the specification or matching test expectations that assume a public method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of getTotalNumberOfStudents() consistent with the UML and problem description by declaring it public. Update the solution implementation to 'public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()' and (if applicable) ensure the template/stub suggests the same visibility so students implement the intended public API.
